dialogues.speaker: "Emergency Notice"
dialogues.text: "Patient Abbas, male, 23 years old. Mole on the left side of forehead, and left-handed. While his condition remains very serious..."

dialogues.speaker: "Emergency Notice"
dialogues.text: "...survival will be difficult without professional medical care. The patient's survivability..."

dialogues.speaker: "Emergency Notice"
dialogues.text: "...don't give up, stay positive. All beings are under the watchful eye of the divine, so don't ever give up."

dialogues.speaker: "Emergency Notice"
dialogues.text: (The rest of the document has been rendered unreadable by weathering.)
